name: nebula
description: Steven Mosley's Claude Code mods and plugins.

plugins.name: nebula-ui
plugins.description: A modern restyle of Claude Code: prompt bars, rich markdown with framed code and tables, clickable tool rows, a live dashboard band, each part switchable from /nebula.

plugins.name: gdh
plugins.description: Lets Claude make Godot 4 games: see and drive them off-screen on the GPU, work through the open editor with real UIDs, check scripts and the API, run tests and export builds.
